lines: Her last text sits saved on the phone.
Opening it always sparks a painful what-if question.
The phone feels like a trophy of false hope.
That’s why deleting it feels like a betrayal.
Holding it traps you in yesterday’s grief.
Move it to a folder called finished or erase it.
Only then will you finally stop hurting yourself.
